reason: Twenty bucks is nothing, but our Slack and Notion setup already works and costs us basically zero. Moving all our docs and tasks, and talking my co-founder into a new app mid-sprint, is a cost I'm not paying for a nicer version of what we have.
objection: My partner won't switch, and a two-person tool only works if both of us actually live in it. I'm also wary of putting the company's docs into a new tool from a company I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: A one-click import of our Notion workspace and Slack history, so moving takes an afternoon instead of a weekend and my partner doesn't have to rebuild anything.
